metadata.description: Practical Claude Code skills for real workflows

plugins.name: done
plugins.description: End-of-session wrap-up: detects what changed, updates CLAUDE.md with gotchas only, runs tests, commits only this session's files (creating a repo with a secret check for new projects), and prints a short status report.

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: Save an unfinished session to a handoffs/ Markdown file (handoff) and pick it back up in a fresh session, with drift checks against the current code (resume-handoff).
